div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
🔤 User Free-Text Utterance / Quick-Add Input
e.g. 'Add 100 g paneer and 2 boiled eggs yesterday'

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1.1 extract_date_from_text()
ISO YYYY-MM-DD, Slash DD/MM/YYYY, 'today'/'yesterday'
Validates calendar date & max 400-day backdate

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1.3 parse_item_text()
Parses leading numbers, fractions ('1 1/2'), number words ('two'),
attached units ('100g'), '2 x eggs', & plausibility bounds
(MAX_COUNT=50, MAX_AMOUNT=5000g/ml)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2.1 get_food_db(user_id)
Merges _BUILTIN_DB + _load_user_custom_entries(user_id)
with mtime/size stat-signature cache

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2.2 _NOT_SAME_AS Negative Phrase Guard
Blocks distinct foods ('paneer tikka', 'protein bar',
'almond milk', 'fried rice', 'egg roll', etc.)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2.3 Build exact_vocab Set
All tokens across all keys & aliases in scoped DB

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2.4 _matched_query_word() & Alias Scoring
• Exact token match first
• Typo-tolerant SequenceMatcher >= 0.80 for len >= 4 & same 1st char
• Anti-hijack guard: exact_vocab tokens NEVER fuzzy-remap
• Ranked by score = (len(alias_words), len(alias_string))

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2.5 Leftover Token & Confidence Verification
leftover_words = qwords - best_matched - FILLER_WORDS - digits
If leftover_words != [] -> low_confidence_match (refuses guess)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2.6 did_you_mean(limit=3)
difflib.get_close_matches(cutoff=0.60) over aliases
Returned as user suggestion only, NEVER auto-applied

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3.2 In-Memory LRU Cache (_CACHE, 500) + _IN_FLIGHT Event Dedup
+ Thread-Local 4.0s Deadline Budget

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3.3 Tier 1: USDA FoodData Central (/fdc/v1/foods/search)
Foundation & SR Legacy • _name_matches() all query words
Extracts nutrients (208/957/958 kcal, 203 P, 205 C, 204 F, 291 fiber)
+ foodMeasures / foodPortions household weights

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3.4 Tier 2: Open Food Facts (v2 Search + CGI Fallback)
Rejects _DERIVATIVE_MODIFIERS (oil, spray, syrup, supplement)
Picks candidate minimizing extra_words = cand_words - q_words

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4.1 coerce_diary_portion() & _convert()
Maps household portions (cup=240ml, tbsp=15ml, tsp=5ml, bowl=200g)
or food-specific portions{} to native unit (g, ml, piece, slice, scoop)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4.2 Linear Scaling & Provenance Tagging
scale = effective_amount / base_amount
Computes rounded kcal, protein, carbs, fat, fiber + provenance

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5.1 _options_by_role() & TEMPLATES Cartesian Product
Filters DB by diet (any/veg/egg) & avoid list
Evaluates portion LADDERS across 12 role templates within [min_kcal, rc]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5.2 Multi-Objective Scoring Function _score()
score = 0.50*protein_score + 0.25*calorie_fill + 0.15*variety + 0.10*preference
Diversifies via _diverse(MAX_PER_MAIN_FOOD=4) + reserves MAX_OWN_FOODS=5

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5.3 validate_recommendation_fit()
Recomputes candidate nutrition from scratch & verifies <= remaining_calories

svg.text: DFD Level 2 — Information Retrieval (IR), Lexical/Fuzzy Matching & Recommendation Scoring Pipeline
